name: streetify-monorepo
description: Streetify - Sri Lankan Urban Ride-Hailing Platform

scripts.backend: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:MAVEN_OPTS = '-Xms64m -Xmx256m'; if (-not $env:JAVA_HOME) { $jdks = Get-ChildItem ($env:USERPROFILE + '\.jdks\*17*'), 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk*17*', 'C:\Program Files\Java\jdk*17*', ($env:USERPROFILE + '\.jdks\*'), 'C:\Program Files\Java\jdk*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($jdks) { $env:JAVA_HOME = ($jdks | Select-Object -First 1).FullName } }; if ($env:JAVA_HOME) { $env:Path = \"$env:JAVA_HOME\bin;$env:Path\" }; cd streetify-backend; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run"
scripts.build:backend: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:MAVEN_OPTS = '-Xms64m -Xmx256m'; if (-not $env:JAVA_HOME) { $jdks = Get-ChildItem ($env:USERPROFILE + '\.jdks\*17*'), 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk*17*', 'C:\Program Files\Java\jdk*17*', ($env:USERPROFILE + '\.jdks\*'), 'C:\Program Files\Java\jdk*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($jdks) { $env:JAVA_HOME = ($jdks | Select-Object -First 1).FullName } }; if ($env:JAVA_HOME) { $env:Path = \"$env:JAVA_HOME\bin;$env:Path\" }; cd streetify-backend; .\mvnw.cmd clean package -DskipTests"
